zh.title: 成员与权限
zh.doorState: 这台服务器 /members、/share-grants、/acl/roles 一扇都没答，所以这一屏今天没有任何一项能真改。下面写的是那几扇门答话之后每一档意味着什么，不是对这条行程下的结论。
roleText: 所有者 全部权限：改可见性、请人、移除成员、删除行程。
管理员 管理协作者、编辑地点。
visibilityRows: 仅个人 别人打不开，拿到链接也打不开。
获得链接者可见 有链接的人不用先进成员名单就能读。
受邀者可见 只有邀请还在有效期内的人打得开，过期就打不开了。
公开 全网公开可见。

转换后，已经在跟踪这条行程的人会失去访问权限。

en.title: MEMBERS AND ACCESS
en.doorState: This server answered none of /members, /share-grants, /acl/roles, so nothing on this screen can be changed today. The ladders say what each level will mean once those doors answer -- they are not a claim about this trip.
roleText: Owner Everything: change visibility, invite people, remove members, delete the trip.
Admin Manage collaborators and edit places.
visibilityRows: Only me No one else can open it, not even holding the link.
Anyone with the link Anyone holding the link can read it without being a member first.
Invited people only Only invitations still in date can open it; an expired one cannot.
Public Visible to everyone on this network.

said: Someone else's role changes, yours stays
That person will get the matching permission.
You hand the trip to someone else
That person will get the matching permission, and your own permission changes with it.
This device could not read your own role
That person will get the matching permission, and your own permission changes with it.
That person will lose access to this trip.

switchLines.said: After this the trip is visible to everyone -- people who could not see it before will be able to.
After this, the people who followed it lose access -- they will not be able to open it any more.
